data.long_description:
Contemporary Living Surrounded by Nature at Golf Dale

Golf Dale is an exclusive residential project by Emaar, nestled within the vibrant Emaar South community. Comprising two modern towers with 11 and 14 residential floors respectively, along with five limited-edition townhouses, the development offers a diverse selection of 1-, 2-, and 3-bedroom homes. Each residence is designed with a modern aesthetic, featuring open-plan layouts, elegant finishes, and expansive windows that invite natural light while offering picturesque views of the surrounding green spaces.

The community is ideal for individuals and families seeking a lifestyle that seamlessly blends urban convenience with tranquil, nature-inspired living. With a host of amenities including a golf course, clubhouse, swimming pools, fitness zones, yoga areas, children’s play zones, and landscaped parks, Golf Dale provides everything needed for a balanced, active lifestyle.
